title: Zanzibar Beach Tour: Luxury at Emerald Zanzibar Resort & Spa
content:
Embark on a luxurious 8-day journey at the Emerald Zanzibar Resort & Spa, starting with a warm welcome upon arrival at Zanzibar Airport. You’ll be transferred to this exquisite retreat located on one of Zanzibar’s finest beaches, where you can unwind with all-inclusive accommodations. Enjoy a seamless blend of relaxation and adventure, from lounging by the pool and strolling along pristine beaches to exploring Matemwe Beach and engaging in optional activities like diving or snorkeling at Mnemba Island Atoll. Each day is designed for you to indulge in the resort’s amenities, soak in the stunning surroundings, and savor delightful dining experiences.

Throughout your stay, you will have ample opportunities to enjoy the resort’s tranquil environment and breathtaking views. Our representative will check in to assist with any needs and help arrange additional activities. As your stay draws to a close, spend your final day relaxing and reflecting on the serene atmosphere before your transfer to Zanzibar Airport for departure. This itinerary promises a perfect balance of leisure and exploration, ensuring a memorable Zanzibar experience filled with relaxation, adventure, and the natural beauty of the island.

Where you stay

Facing the beachfront, The Emerald Zanzibar Resort & Spa  offers 5-star accommodation in Matemwe and has a garden, private beach area and terrace. Among the facilities at this property are room service and a business centre, along with free WiFi throughout the property. The resort features an outdoor swimming pool, fitness centre, evening entertainment and a kids’ club.

faqs.title: Peak Season: June to October
faqs.content:
The dry season from June to October is the most popular time to visit Zanzibar. During these months, the weather is warm and dry, with little to no rainfall, making it perfect for beach holidays and outdoor activities.

This is also a great time to combine your Zanzibar visit with a safari on mainland Tanzania, as it aligns with the peak season for wildlife viewing. Expect clear skies, calm seas, and bustling markets during this period.

faqs.title: Short Dry Season: January to February
faqs.content: The short dry spell between January and February is another fantastic time to explore Zanzibar. While temperatures are slightly higher, the sunny days and clear waters are perfect for water sports like snorkeling, scuba diving, and kite surfing. This period also sees fewer crowds compared to the mid-year peak season, allowing for a more tranquil experience.

faqs.title: Rainy Seasons: March to May and November to December
faqs.content:
The long rains from March to May bring heavy downpours and high humidity, making this period the off-season for tourism. While some activities may be limited and certain lodges closed, this time is ideal for budget-conscious travelers, as many hotels and resorts offer discounted rates.

The short rainy season in November and December brings occasional showers, mostly in the late afternoon or evening. These light rains are less disruptive, and visitors can still enjoy beach activities, spice tours, and cultural excursions. With fewer crowds and lower prices, this period is perfect for those seeking a quieter getaway.

faqs.title: Marine Adventures
faqs.content:
For diving and snorkeling enthusiasts, the best visibility under the Indian Ocean’s turquoise waters occurs between November and March. This is also an excellent time for dolphin spotting and exploring Mnemba Atoll, renowned for its marine biodiversity.

By choosing the right season, you can ensure your trip to Zanzibar aligns perfectly with your interests, whether it’s enjoying sunny beaches, vibrant marine life, or cultural exploration.

faqs.title: What is the best time to visit Zanzibar?
faqs.content: The best time to visit Zanzibar is during the dry season, which runs from June to October and December to February. During these months, the weather is warm and pleasant, perfect for beach activities, sightseeing, and outdoor adventures. The wet season, from March to May, brings heavier rains, so it’s advisable to avoid this time for a beach holiday.

faqs.title: Do I need a visa to visit Zanzibar?
faqs.content: Zanzibar is part of Tanzania, so you will need a visa to enter if you’re not from a visa-exempt country. Many visitors can obtain a tourist visa upon arrival at the airport or apply for an e-visa online before travel. Always check the latest visa requirements based on your nationality before planning your trip.

faqs.title: What currency is used in Zanzibar?
faqs.content: The official currency of Zanzibar is the Tanzanian Shilling (TZS), although US Dollars are widely accepted in many hotels, shops, and tourist areas. It’s advisable to carry some local currency for small purchases or when visiting less touristy areas.

faqs.title: Is Zanzibar safe for tourists?
faqs.content: Zanzibar is generally safe for tourists, with friendly locals and a welcoming atmosphere. However, like in any tourist destination, it’s important to take precautions such as safeguarding your belongings, avoiding isolated areas at night, and using reputable transport services.

faqs.title: What are the top attractions in Zanzibar?
faqs.content:
Some of the must-see attractions in Zanzibar include:

- Stone Town: A UNESCO World Heritage Site known for its historical sites, including the House of Wonders and the Old Fort.

- Spice Farms: Learn about Zanzibar’s history as the “Spice Island” and enjoy a guided tour of spice plantations.

- Prison Island: A short boat ride from Stone Town, famous for its giant tortoises and beautiful beaches.

- Nungwi and Kendwa Beaches: Ideal for swimming, snorkeling, and enjoying the crystal-clear waters of the Indian Ocean.

faqs.title: What activities can I do in Zanzibar?
faqs.content:
Zanzibar offers a wide range of activities:

- Beach activities: Swimming, snorkeling, diving, and kite surfing on its pristine beaches.

- Cultural tours: Visit historical sites, spice farms, and engage with local communities to learn about their culture.

- Safari trips to the mainland: Combine a beach holiday with a safari in the national parks like Serengeti and Ngorongoro Crater.

- Boat trips: Go on a dhow cruise or explore nearby islands like Prison Island and Changuu Island.

faqs.title: What should I pack for a trip to Zanzibar?
faqs.content: For a Zanzibar trip, pack light, breathable clothes suitable for warm weather. Don’t forget swimwear, sunscreen, a hat, sunglasses, insect repellent, and comfortable shoes for walking tours. If you plan to visit religious sites, ensure you have modest clothing that covers the shoulders and knees.

faqs.title: Is Zanzibar suitable for family holidays?
faqs.content: Yes, Zanzibar is an excellent destination for families. With its beautiful beaches, family-friendly resorts, and exciting activities like snorkeling, boat tours, and wildlife experiences, there’s something for all ages. Many resorts also offer childcare services and kids’ activities.

faqs.title: Can I visit Zanzibar for a honeymoon?
faqs.content: Zanzibar is a popular honeymoon destination due to its romantic ambiance, luxurious beachfront resorts, and private villas. Enjoy sunset dhow cruises, intimate dinners on the beach, and spa treatments in paradise.

faqs.title: What kind of accommodations are available in Zanzibar?
faqs.content: Zanzibar offers a variety of accommodations, ranging from luxury resorts, boutique hotels, and eco-lodges to budget-friendly guesthouses. There are options to suit every type of traveler, whether you prefer a luxurious beachside retreat or a charming, rustic experience.

faqs.title: Is it possible to combine a Zanzibar beach holiday with a safari?
faqs.content: Yes! Zanzibar is often paired with a safari in mainland Tanzania. A Zanzibar safari and beach holiday is a popular option, offering the best of both worlds: thrilling wildlife encounters in Tanzania’s national parks, followed by a relaxing beach stay on Zanzibar’s idyllic shores.

faqs.title: What language is spoken in Zanzibar?
faqs.content: The official languages of Zanzibar are Swahili and English. Swahili is the most widely spoken language, but many people in the tourist industry also speak English, making communication easy for international visitors.

faqs.title: What is the food like in Zanzibar?
faqs.content: Zanzibar’s cuisine is influenced by a blend of African, Arab, Indian, and Portuguese cultures. Enjoy flavorful dishes such as biryani, pilau, seafood, and fresh tropical fruits. Zanzibar is also famous for its spices, so don’t miss the opportunity to taste dishes seasoned with cloves, nutmeg, and cinnamon.

itinerary.title: Day 1
itinerary.content:
Upon arrival at Zanzibar Airport, you will be warmly welcomed and privately transferred to Zanzibar Queen Hotel, set on the stunning northeastern coast in Matemwe. Located just over an hour away, this peaceful retreat offers a chance to unwind immediately upon check-in. Settle into your comfortable accommodations, and take in the serene beachside surroundings, where crystal-clear waters and beautiful ocean views await.

Spend the rest of the day at your leisure: enjoy a refreshing swim, stroll along the white sand, or relax by the resort’s pool. Dinner will be served in the evening, providing an opportunity to savor local flavors while settling into the relaxing ambiance of the resort—perfectly setting the stage for the days to come.

Overnight: Emerald Zanzibar Resort & Spa

itinerary.title: Day 2
itinerary.desc: Leisure Day at Zanzibar Queen Hotel
itinerary.content:
Start your day with a delightful breakfast at the resort. Spend the day enjoying the luxurious amenities of Emerald Zanzibar Resort & Spa. Whether you choose to lounge by the pool, take a stroll on the pristine beach, or simply relax in the tranquil surroundings, you will have ample time to unwind. At around 5:00 PM, our representative will check in to assist you with any needs or to arrange additional activities or excursions.

Explore more of Zanzibar or enhance your resort experience with optional tours or treatments. In the evening, indulge in a delectable dinner at the resort before retreating to your comfortable accommodations for a restful night’s sleep.

Overnight: Emerald Zanzibar Resort & Spa

itinerary.title: Day 3
itinerary.content:
Enjoy a leisurely day at Emerald Zanzibar Resort & Spa. You can spend your time relaxing on the beach, swimming in the pool, or exploring the various resort facilities at your own pace. If you’re feeling adventurous, consider arranging a diving or snorkeling trip to the nearby Mnemba Island Atoll, renowned for its vibrant marine life and stunning underwater landscapes.

After a fulfilling day, return to the resort to enjoy a delightful dinner featuring a selection of local and international dishes. Unwind in your comfortable accommodations, reflecting on a day filled with relaxation or exploration, as you prepare for another exciting day in paradise.

Overnight: Emerald Zanzibar Resort & Spa

itinerary.title: Day 4
itinerary.desc: Leisure or Optional Activities at Matemwe Beach
itinerary.content:
Begin your day with a delicious breakfast at Emerald Zanzibar Resort & Spa before heading to Matemwe Beach, known for its stunning beauty and relaxed atmosphere. Spend the morning basking in the sun, swimming, or simply enjoying the beautiful surroundings. You can also choose to engage in optional activities, such as paddleboarding or visiting local villages to experience the culture of Zanzibar.

Return to the resort in the afternoon to unwind, followed by a delightful dinner featuring fresh seafood and local delicacies. As the day comes to a close, enjoy the tranquility of your accommodations, preparing for more relaxation or adventure in the days ahead.

Overnight: Emerald Zanzibar Resort & Spa

itinerary.title: Day 5
itinerary.content:
Start your day with a leisurely breakfast at Emerald Zanzibar Resort & Spa, setting the stage for a full day of relaxation. Take advantage of the resort’s amenities by sunbathing on the pristine beaches or swimming in the clear waters of the Indian Ocean. You might also choose to explore the resort’s facilities, including the spa or fitness center.

Enjoy lunch at the resort, sampling local flavors and fresh ingredients. In the evening, indulge in a sumptuous dinner, perhaps dining under the stars with the soothing sounds of the ocean in the background. Afterward, retreat to your luxurious accommodations for a restful overnight stay, reflecting on a perfect day in paradise.

Overnight: Emerald Zanzibar Resort & Spa

itinerary.title: Day 6
itinerary.content:
After a delicious breakfast, dedicate your day to relaxation at Emerald Zanzibar Resort & Spa. Enjoy the stunning views of Mnemba Island while lounging by the pool or strolling along the beach. Take the opportunity to immerse yourself in the serene environment and luxurious amenities available at the resort.

You might choose to engage in a yoga class or simply relax with a good book. As evening approaches, savor a delightful dinner at the resort, featuring a variety of culinary options. Spend your night in comfortable accommodations, reflecting on the beauty of the surroundings and the peace of mind that comes from a day well spent.

Overnight: Emerald Zanzibar Resort & Spa

itinerary.title: Day 7
itinerary.content:
Experience another full day of leisure at Emerald Zanzibar Resort & Spa. Spend the day relaxing by the sea, soaking up the sun, or admiring the picturesque views of Mnemba Island. Whether lounging on the beach, participating in water sports, or enjoying the resort’s spa treatments, you will have plenty of opportunities to unwind.

In the afternoon, consider exploring the nearby area or participating in organized excursions if you seek adventure. As the day comes to a close, enjoy a delicious dinner at the resort, reflecting on your day of relaxation and scenic beauty. Return to your luxurious accommodations for a comfortable overnight stay.

Overnight: Emerald Zanzibar Resort & Spa

itinerary.title: Day 8
itinerary.content: After your final breakfast at Emerald Zanzibar Resort & Spa, enjoy a leisurely half-day to savor the last moments of your stay. Spend your morning relaxing by the pool or taking a final stroll along the beach, soaking in the tranquil atmosphere one last time. Capture the beautiful scenery and memories of your trip before checking out. Later, you will be transferred to Zanzibar Airport for your departure flight. Reflect on your memorable experiences, the breathtaking landscapes, and the serenity of your time in Zanzibar as you make your way to the airport, taking with you the beauty and tranquility of the island.
